stem: Which statement correctly compares the southern colonies and the middle colonies?

options.label: A
options.text: The southern colonies required less labor than the middle colonies.

options.label: B
options.text: The southern colonies attracted more immigrants than the middle colonies.

options.label: C
options.text: The middle colonies had more diverse economies than the southern colonies.

options.label: D
options.text: The middle colonies were less dependent on skilled labor than the southern colonies.
